description:
Located within the Belas Clube de Campo development in Sintra, this single-family house is set on a plot with challenging topography, a condition that becomes a defining factor in the project’s spatial and volumetric strategy.

Conceived as a seven-bedroom residence, the house integrates, in addition to the main living and private areas, an extensive complementary program. The semi-basement level accommodates the garage, gym, sauna, indoor swimming pool, and leisure spaces including a billiard room and home cinema, allowing the upper floors to remain more open and fluid.

The volumetric composition is organized around an L-shaped form, carefully adjusted to the terrain’s profile. This configuration frees the exterior space to the rear of the plot, enabling the creation of a garden and outdoor swimming pool and strengthening the relationship between interior and exterior spaces.

Formally, the building is defined by intersecting white volumes that frame darker planes articulated through color and glass. These elements are set between the overhangs of the extensive balconies, creating a layered composition of solids and voids that lends depth, rhythm, and a contemporary architectural expression to the project.
